result.title: Dual-Scale Condition-Shift Editing for Robust Real-World Image Demoiréing
result.summary: Robust demoiréing of screen-recaptured images remains challenging: moiré varies in frequency, color, and spatial support across display-camera pairs and capture conditions. Dedicated restoration networks trained on finite paired data struggle with this diversity, especially when low-frequency color banding and high-frequency stripes co-occur. We present DemoiréEdit, a content-preserving editing framework that adapts the natural-image prior of a pretrained flow-matching editor to demoiréing. First, an endpoint-supervised training objective supplements velocity matching with pixel, perceptual, and frequency-domain restoration losses. Second, a dual-scale condition-shift strategy performs global correction at low resolution, then refines the image at full resolution by shifting the denoising condition from the first-stage output to the original input for detail recovery. We also introduce DailyMoiré130, a benchmark of challenging moiré in everyday screen photography, comprising 130 smartphone captures across diverse displays with low-frequency color banding, fine high-frequency stripes, and mixed-frequency interference. On the challenging DailyMoiré130 benchmark, our method achieves the lowest residual moiré area and receives 71.3% overall-quality preference in a blind Best-of-7 study with 31 participants. We also evaluate on paired FHDMi/UHDM, reducing residual moiré confidence by 47.1%/9.3% and increasing MUSIQ by 4.3%/2.0% over the best baseline for each metric.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 DemoiréEdit，把预训练 flow-matching 编辑器适配到屏摄图像去摩尔纹：以端点监督加像素、感知与频域损失训练，并用双尺度条件偏移策略先低分辨率全局校正、再全分辨率细化，同时发布 DailyMoiré130 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于像素级图像复原/编辑任务，不涉及视觉推理状态、证据获取或答案生成；其双尺度条件偏移与端点监督只是去摩尔纹的特定训练与采样技巧，与 LVR 的 latent 状态生成、使用和监督之间没有可核查的具体借鉴线索，故排除。
